CheckTitle: S3 Bucket Policy Grants Access to External Accounts
Description: S3 bucket policies do not limit access to the owning AWS account or explicitly authorized cross-account principals.
Risk: Unrestricted cross-account permissions may allow unauthorized external AWS accounts to view, download, or tamper with sensitive bucket contents, bypassing internal access boundaries and risking regulatory non-compliance.

Recommendation.Text: Audit S3 bucket policies to ensure external account access is disabled unless specifically required for cross-account architecture. Where cross-account access is required, enforce conditions such as aws:PrincipalOrgID or explicit account lists.
